heading: Two focused apps. One reason: speed for the person who just wants the game.
subhead: A fan walking in for the second half doesn't want a discovery platform — they want sound in eight seconds. A guest planning tonight wants the whole calendar. Audeohost builds for both instead of compromising on either.

cards.title: The "I just want the game" app
cards.text: No account, no backend — connect to the venue's Wi-Fi and pick a channel. Built for the walk-in fan, low battery and all, with Coming Up / Venue Highlights under the player for menu, specials and what's next.

cards.title: The "what's on tonight" app
cards.text: Full venue discovery — agendas, fixtures, in-house nights, directions — with live audio and the same Coming Up / Venue Highlights promotion built in. Favourite a venue once, see everything it schedules from then on.

beatStrip: Behind both apps: Audeo-Server — your sound. Audeo-Portal — your team publishes every event; your guest has the rest in Audeohost-Events.
